epd_name: Pemko Silicone Adhesive Smoke and Fire Gasket
description: Product name: Pemko Silicon Adhesive Smoke and Fire Gasket Pemko produces a range of gasket products in a variety of shapes and configurations. Nine gasket configurations have been analyzed, and this EPD presents the worst case scenario for these nine variations. Specifically, this EPD is representative of the following Pemko gasket products: - S44 - S77 - S88 - S442 - S771 - S772 - S773 - S776 - S771x6 Pemko Silicon Adhesive Smoke and Fire Gaskets are adhesive-backed, silicone gasketing products installed on the perimeter of a door opening or at the meeting edges of a pair of doors to slow/prohibit the passage of smoke, fire, weather, sound, and dirt. They are rigorously tested and offered in many colors (finishes) guaranteed to blend unobrusively into any structure. Addtional features include: - Effective temperature range of -58 to +450 degrees Farenheit - Manufactured using high quality cross linked silicon polymer - Includes high quality acrylic adhesive for secure application - Exceeds air infiltration ratings by a factor of 7 or better - Is 93% efficient for sound control when applied in a double row - Self-extinguishing, non-toxic - Unaffected by sunlight, ozone, and ultraviolet rays - Impervious to fungus and mildew - Product is packaged with an alcohol towelette for frame cleaning and a mylar label. Otherwise, no other accessory materials are required for installation or use. Application Pemko Silicone Adhesive Gaskets are ideal for a wide range of applications, including but not limited to high traffic areas, hotels, offices, public buildings, hospitals, institutions, educational facilities, and retail spaces. Zero’s patented automatic door bottom technology ensures an efficient seal against the floor or saddle. As the door is
closed, the adjustable plunger is compressed against the door frame, activating a concealed flat spring mechanism. This
mechanism drops the seal smoothly from the housing in a scissor-like motion as illustrated below. The door seal
compresses on either even or uneven surfaces and retracts automatically when the door is opened. All Zero automatic
door bottoms function the same way. The concealed spring mechanism causes the insert seal to activate on the hinge
side first. It prevents the seal from dragging along the floor or threshold while the door is being closed to avoid door
hang-up or closing delay.

Weatherstripping is installed around openings, especially doors and windows in buildings to keep out weather, increase interior
comfort, lower utility bills and reduce noise. It also prevents rain and water from entering by rerouting or returning water. This EPD
considers an average product based on fifteen products in the Jamb weatherstripping line of products. Weatherstripping products
are usually composed of primarily two materials, a metal and a gasket. All weatherstripping considered in this study are aluminum
extrusions of alloy 6063-T5 and 6061-T6. Gasketing is available in a variety of materials, including vinyl, neoprene in a solid and
sponge, and silicone. The regular weatherstripping product along with gasketing has been considered in this study. Average
weights for the products disclosed in this EPD are provided in the Declared Unit section below. The standard application is one
weatherstrip per standard 3’0” x 7’0” door leaf. This EPD presents results for this application.
